WITH l AS (
 SELECT f.receipt_id, f.sale_date, s.store_id, f.staff_purchase_flag, p.category, f.channel_code, f.net_amount, f.quantity
 FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
 WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-03' AND DATE '2026-08-30')
SELECT 'receipts spanning >1 store/date' k, count(*) v FROM (SELECT receipt_id FROM l GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(distinct store_id)>1 OR count(distinct sale_date)>1)
UNION ALL SELECT 'receipts mixed staff flag', count(*) FROM (SELECT receipt_id FROM l GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(distinct staff_purchase_flag)>1)
UNION ALL SELECT 'lines store>=900', count(*) FROM l WHERE store_id>=900
UNION ALL SELECT 'lines store 999', count(*) FROM l WHERE store_id=999
UNION ALL SELECT 'lines ZZ Test', count(*) FROM l WHERE category='ZZ Test'
UNION ALL SELECT 'lines staff', count(*) FROM l WHERE staff_purchase_flag
UNION ALL SELECT 'lines qty<=0 or net<=0', count(*) FROM l WHERE quantity<=0 OR net_amount<=0
UNION ALL SELECT 'null staff flag', count(*) FROM l WHERE staff_purchase_flag IS NULL

calls.statement:
WITH params AS (SELECT 'FY2026/27' AS fiscal_year, 4 AS fiscal_period)
SELECT s.format,
       COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) AS receipts,
       SUM(f.net_amount) AS net_sales_before_returns,
       ROUND(SUM(f.net_amount) / COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id), 2) AS atv
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
JOIN dim_date d    ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
CROSS JOIN params
WHERE s.store_id < 900
  AND NOT f.staff_purchase_flag
  AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
  AND d.fiscal_year = params.fiscal_year
  AND d.fiscal_period = params.fiscal_period
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

WITH l AS (
 SELECT s.store_id, f.sale_date, sum(f.net_amount) net, count(distinct f.receipt_id) rc
 FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
 WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-03' AND DATE '2026-08-30' AND s.store_id<900 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
 GROUP BY 1,2)
SELECT count(*) mismatches, sum(l.net - r.net_sales_before_returns) net_gap, sum(l.rc - r.receipts) rc_gap
FROM l FULL JOIN rpt_daily_store_sales r ON r.store_id=l.store_id AND r.business_date=l.sale_date
WHERE r.business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-03' AND DATE '2026-08-30' AND r.store_id<900
  AND (abs(coalesce(l.net,0)-r.net_sales_before_returns)>0.005 OR coalesce(l.rc,0)<>r.receipts)
